<ticket id="T-0012" kind="chore" seat="harness-core-llm-pi-ai-steward">
title: Drop the test-only supportedProtocols root export from dsh-llm-pi-ai
task: Problem: packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts:82 re-exports `supportedProtocols` from src/provider.ts. Its only importer outside src is packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/catalog.spec.ts; no other package, app or example uses it and the README does not name it. The proposed prune note's grouped inventory targets this package's helper exports as SDK surface without an owner.

Required: remove the root re-export on index.ts:82 and change catalog.spec.ts to import `../src/provider.ts` (package-local test imports are the existing convention). Keep `supportedProtocols` exported from provider.ts if another module in src imports it; if `pnpm run knip` reports it as an export used only in its own file, drop the `export` keyword and let the test exercise the behavior through the public catalog instead. No behavior change.

Constraints: mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption; do not touch other exports.
scope: packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/
acceptance:
- export-gone: ! grep -q 'supportedProtocols' packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts
- coverage: pnpm exec vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/ --coverage --coverage.include='packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/**/*.ts'
- typecheck: pnpm run typecheck
</ticket>

diff --git a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md
index 6a66b7690d..01316c1a61 100644
--- a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md
+++ b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ English | [中文](README.zh.md)
 
 Generic multi-provider adapter for the harness LLM seam backed by [`@earendil-works/pi-ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-ai). One plugin instance owns a dict of provider profiles keyed by route; every request selects a profile with `GenerateOptions.provider` and resolves `GenerateOptions.model` against that route's configured catalog. A route naming an installed pi-ai provider inherits its endpoint, wire protocol, and model catalog as defaults and overrides them field by field; a route pi-ai does not ship is declared outright, so an OpenAI-compatible gateway, a self-hosted server, or a provider newer than the installed catalog is configuration rather than a code change.
 
-The package root exposes the Cordis plugin contract, `PiAiAdapter`, and `supportedProtocols()`; profile resolution, catalog materialization, provider construction, replay conversion, and stream conversion remain package-internal.
+The package root exposes the Cordis plugin contract and `PiAiAdapter`; profile resolution, catalog materialization, provider construction, replay conversion, and stream conversion remain package-internal.
 
 ## Config
 
diff --git a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.zh.md b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.zh.md
index e51d6fb021..e4866730e3 100644
--- a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.zh.md
+++ b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.zh.md
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 
 基于 [`@earendil-works/pi-ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-ai) 的 harness LLM（大语言模型）seam 通用多提供方适配器。一个插件实例拥有一份以路由为键的提供方 profile 字典；每个请求使用 `GenerateOptions.provider` 选择 profile，并针对该路由已配置的 catalog 解析 `GenerateOptions.model`。点名了已安装 pi-ai 提供方的路由会继承其端点、协议格式（wire format）与模型 catalog 作为默认值，并逐字段覆盖；pi-ai 未提供的路由则整体声明出来，因此接入 OpenAI 兼容网关、自建服务，或比已安装 catalog 更新的提供方，都属于配置而非改代码。
 
-包根入口导出 Cordis 插件约定、`PiAiAdapter` 与 `supportedProtocols()`；profile 解析、catalog 物化、提供方构造、回放转换和流转换保留在包内部。
+包根入口导出 Cordis 插件约定与 `PiAiAdapter`；profile 解析、catalog 物化、提供方构造、回放转换和流转换保留在包内部。
 
 ## 配置
 
diff --git a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts
index 2e550771fc..915ecbbce2 100644
--- a/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts
+++ b/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts
@@ -79,7 +79,6 @@ export type {
   PiAiThinkingFormat,
   ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile,
 } from './config.ts'
-export { supportedProtocols } from './provider.ts'
 
 export const name = 'llm-pi-ai'
 export const inject = ['llm']
</diff>
